name: OGC Application Package
abstract: Conformance class for OGC API — Processes Part 2 (DRAFT). Defines the schema of an OGC Application Package document — a formal process description used to dynamically deploy or replace a process — and the media type (application/ogcapppkg+json) used to carry it in requests and responses.

sources.title: OGC API - Processes - Part 2: Deploy, Replace, Undeploy
